blocks.title: range() function
blocks.text: range() adad ki sequence banata hai aur aksar for loops mein istemal hota hai: range(stop), range(start, stop) ya range(start, stop, step). stop ki qeemat shamil nahi hoti.
Class activities: temperatures ki list par chal kar 20 degree se zyada par "Warm" aur warna "Cold" print karein; range() se 2 se 10 tak juft adad print karein; 3 ke pehle 10 mazrab print karein.

blocks.prompt: range() kya karta hai (MCQ 7)? for loop mein range() ka istemal samjhaiye (short question 5).
blocks.explanation: Yeh adad ki sequence banata hai, option (b). for loop mein yeh tay karta hai ke loop kitni baar chale aur loop variable kaunse adad le: for i in range(2, 11, 2) se 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, aur for i in range(1, 11): print(3 * i) 3 ke pehle 10 mazrab print karta hai.

items: range(stop), range(start, stop), range(start, stop, step); stop shamil nahi; range(5) yaani 0 se 4.
